title.narrative: SAWEA: Positioning wind energy as a contributor to global decarbonisation strategies

description.narrative: Positioning wind energy as a contributor to global decarbonisation strategies, though providing education and awareness of renewable energy sources to learners in high school, internship opportunities for graduates, access to academia through research studies and Wind Academic conference and networking and information sharing of key industry stakeholders.

The South African Wind Energy Association (SAWEA) is a not-for-profit industry association advocating for the accelerated growth of wind energy in South Africa. It aims to promote a sustainable sector by influencing a better policy environment to provide substantial benefit for the nation.
As the representative voice of the wind industry in South Africa, SAWEA is constantly working towards facilitating dialogue between the wind sector and all key stakeholders. The support to SAWEA will be towards the five below initiatives:
1. WindAC Africa Conference 2. Mpumalanga EnergyDRIVE 3. SAWEA Networking Events 4. SAWEA Wind Industry Internship Programme (WIIP) 5. SAWEA Research Studies
